recommendations.title: Luminaires - Specification for LED Street Lighting and General Lighting Requirements
recommendations.description: Specifies performance, safety, and testing requirements for luminaires including LED-based street lighting fixtures. Covers ingress protection IP65 minimum for outdoor use, thermal management, photometric performance, power factor minimum 0.90, surge protection 10 kV, and operating temperature -20 to 50 degrees C. Part 5 Section 3 specifically addresses LED road and street luminaires for municipal and highway applications with rated life 50000 hours.

recommendations.title: Solid State Lighting Products - LED Street Lights Performance Requirements
recommendations.description: Specifies minimum performance requirements for complete LED street light systems. Covers minimum system efficacy 90 lm/W, CRI minimum 70, correlated colour temperature 2700K to 6500K, power factor minimum 0.90, total harmonic distortion THD below 20 percent, surge protection 10 kV line to earth, rated life 50000 hours at L80, ingress protection IP66 for complete luminaire, and operating voltage 180-270V AC.

recommendations.title: Luminaires Part 5 Section 3 - LED Road and Street Luminaires
recommendations.description: Particular requirements for LED road and street luminaires for outdoor public lighting on highways and municipal streets. Specifies photometric classification, luminous intensity distribution, power consumption 40-250W, ingress protection IP65 or higher, IK08 mechanical impact rating, surge protection 10 kV line to earth, operating voltage 180-270V AC, and rated life L80 at 50000 hours minimum.

recommendations.title: LED Module for General Lighting - Safety Requirements
recommendations.description: Specifies safety requirements for LED modules for incorporation into luminaires for general lighting. Covers maximum case temperature 105 degrees C, electrical insulation, protection against accidental contact with live parts, module identification, and compatibility with LED drivers. Operating voltage up to 250V AC with warranty minimum 3 years for outdoor modules.

recommendations.title: LED Module for General Lighting - Performance Requirements
recommendations.description: Specifies performance requirements for LED modules in luminaires, including initial luminous flux, forward voltage, colour rendering index CRI minimum 70, correlated colour temperature 4000K typical for street lighting, lumen maintenance L80 at 50000 hours, and colour consistency within 3-step MacAdam ellipse. Ensures long-term photometric stability at operating temperatures -20 to 50 degrees C.
